notes.title: Patch 1.04 Boss Rush Mode!
notes.notes:
Hi! This update includes the Boss Rush Mode. After defeating the Elven Lord for the first time you will gain access to the Bonus Boss Rush mode. Fight all 5 bosses in a row in 1 life to test your skill! Earn achievements for beating it as both KnightMan and RogueElf!

Update:

- Added the Boss Rush mode which is unlocked after defeating the final boss
- Added some more achievements related to the Boss Rush Mode

Bugfixes:

-Included some minor bug fixes.


This will be the last content update for while as I now prepare for my next project!

Stay tuned for news about my next project which will be a vertical scrolling bullet hell shootem-up with light RPG elements. 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 1.03 New Playable Character! RogueElf!
notes.notes:
Hello!

I am proud to announce the release of a new playable character in KnightMan.

Introducing RogueElf! A dagger wielding turncoat who has betrayed the Elven Lord and has sworn to help KnightMan in his noble quest. Collect 4 Rogue Tokens scattered throughout the Forest zone and the Undead zone in order to unlock this new playable Character. RogueElf does not benefit from purchases from the shop, but instead has his own built in skills and perks, such as Double Jump and the ability to throw daggers Up and Down when pressing the corresponding keys, as well as separate unique powers when collecting the Fire, Ice and Lightening powerups. 

Update:

- Added New playable character, RogueElf, to the map menu.
- Added collectable Tokens to the first 2 zones which must be collected to unlock RogueElf.

Keep an eye out for the next update which will include a boss rush mode!

notes.title: Patch 1.02c Achievements and small bugfix
notes.notes:
Hey there. Just a small update.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed an issue with audio level not being remembered when exiting and entering the application.

Update: 

- Added steam integration and steam achievements to the game. 

Known issues**

It appears that a watermark at the left hand bottom of the screen has appeared stating "trial version" where on previous builds there were none. This seems to be an issue on Unity's end and is currently under investigation. Please bare with is in the meantime as I have chosen to go ahead with this build release for the sake of including achievements in the game.

This game is the full release and not a trial. 

Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Patch 1.02. Some bug fixes and a small update.
notes.notes:
Hey there! Here is a small patch with some bug fixes and an Update featuring a Medal System.

Bug fixes:

- Fixed a bug that causes the "save maiden" sound to randomly play on some levels when killing an enemy

- Fixed a bug that caused the mouse to disappear when the "esc" key was pressed during the pause menu

-Fixed a bug that caused the sound slider and the fullscreen toggle button to not be visually remembered when exiting the options menu and returning to it.

-Fixed a bug that caused the sound slider to not function correctly.(Also, now defaults to 75% on first play)

-Fixed a bug that caused the writing on some of the Shrines to appear in reverse.

Updates:

-Medals! Added a Medal system to the game that displays a Gold, Silver or Bronze medal at the end of each level depending on how many coins you have picked up. These medals will also show up next to each level in the MAP menu, tracking how well you have done. See you if you can get Gold on every level!

-Adjusted the crumbling platforms on level 6 to be more forgiving

-Every Maiden on every level will now also grant a small amount of gold when saved

Stay tuned for future updates! 

Coming soon:

-Boss rush mode

-Steam achievements
